definition: The named errors the corpus reads for one style by name: the style holds an exception to each, earned or not, inverts it, or has a severity of its own for it.
basis: Our wording of the first of three groups a style's faults fall into. schema/fault.schema.json names the three things a fault record may say about one style: its exceptions, "Where this is NOT a fault. Some styles play with an element far more than others"; its inversions, "Where the OPPOSITE is the fault. A crisp arris is correct almost everywhere"; and its severities, "Severity is not uniform. A missing chimney is fatal on Tudor Revival and Prairie and unremarkable on a ranch". mcp_server/core.py, find_faults: "Faults are element-first: most are universal, and style is a facet."
